data.name: Shreekant
data.gender_notes: Shreekant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shreekant is derived from two Sanskrit words - Shri, meaning God or wealth, and Kant, meaning desire or longing. Hence, Shreekant can be interpreted as the one who has a deep longing or desire for wealth and prosperity. It is also considered to be a name of Lord Vishnu. The name Shreekant carries the meaning “God of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shreekant usually hope their child will grow to embody god of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the deep yearning and devotion towards the divine God of wealth and prosperity, Lord Vishnu.
data.etymology: Shreekant belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shreekant total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

In many Hindu households, parents often name their child Shreekant in the hopes that they will be blessed with good fortune and success.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shreekant signifies the longing and desire for spiritual wealth and prosperity. It reflects the deep inner yearning of an individual to seek peace, happiness, and fulfillment through a connection with the Divine. The name also carries the blessings of Lord Vishnu, who is the embodiment of wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
